title: Swaps v2 has arrived! | Rainbow
summary: This week, we see quick fixes for the app and the release of Swaps v2 to improvements to our swap aggregator.
body_markdown:
### The new Rainbow Swaps:


We've rebuilt Rainbow Swaps from the ground up to bring you the best mobile trading experience.


In this 1st major update, we made memecoins first class citizens in Rainbow. Speed is key when you’re trading tokens. That’s why we’ve optimized our backend and interface to keep you moving at full speed.


### Meet your new ride:


1.


Quickly copy & paste the token address or search into the updated search bar


2.


Immediately use our new slider to easily size your swap.


3.


Don’t worry about the input token. Rainbow intelligently sets your input token to the token you have most of, on the chain you use most.


4.


Submit Trade
